title: Seán Finn and the Late Bloomers blossom with enticing groove in “Late Bloomer”
htmlContent: “Late Bloomer,” the new single from Seán Finn and the Late Bloomers, settles deep into your heart, enveloping you in a dreamy vibe and making you want to groove along to its catchy rhythm. “Late Bloomer” reveals itself slowly, like a beautiful discovery. You can feel hints of the warm and smooth style of Frank Ocean mixed with the relaxed, easygoing feel of Mac DeMarco. However, instead of just taking you on a reflective trip, the band adds a special energy that makes the song entirely their own. The lush vocal harmonies float over a lively bassline that keeps things moving, creating a captivating tension behind the song’s gentle appearance. The lead guitar flies in and out like a voice, adding excitement to the calm atmosphere. https://open.spotify.com/track/6v4YG3UoGukiMNHuLmXlse It feels like a ballad, but it’s full of life, always finding a way to pull you back in with clever shifts in rhythm or unexpected melodies. “Late Bloomer” is a vibe, a moment you’ll want to experience again. Seán Finn and the Late Bloomers have created something that resonates with you and resonates in your ears and heart. Follow on: Instagram
